trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a lump sum for any disease or injury, including cancer, heart attack, stroke, complications and conditions not yet discovered, scored on four severity factors instead of a named-disease list.

keyFigures.label: Severity factors
keyFigures.value: 4: Surgery, Intensive Hospital Stay, Disability, Treatment

keyFigures.label: Scope
keyFigures.value: Every disease and injury, including new diseases not yet discovered

keyFigures.label: Benefit term
keyFigures.condition: as shown in Cover at a glance

exclusionsOrConditions: Payout depends on the severity score, not on meeting a named-disease definition.
Each severity factor is defined in the policy contract and definitions control the claim.
This plan is not a VHIS Certified Plan and premiums are not eligible for tax deduction.

trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, there is no named-disease list - any illness or injury is scored on four severity factors, so new diseases are not automatically excluded.

trends.notesForReviewer: The claim that every disease is covered is marketing language; the policy contract's severity definitions and exclusions govern.

trends.whatProductOffers: Structures the payout in two layers: a Severe Condition Benefit of up to 120% of the Sum Assured plus an Extra Benefit on Extremely Serious Condition of up to 40%, for a maximum of 160%.

keyFigures.label: Score-based cap
keyFigures.condition: for claims with a score of 3 or 4 points

exclusionsOrConditions: The extra 40% applies only when the condition reaches Extremely Serious.
Claims with a score of 3 or 4 points are capped at US$50,000 / HK$400,000 / MOP400,000 per insured.
The treatment factor adds 40% for Specific Target Cancer or 20% for failure of Specific Organs, depending on the trigger.
Disability claims require permanent inability to perform ADLs for 3 continuous months.

trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, a serious condition can pay up to 160% of the sum assured - 120% base plus 40% for extremely serious cases.

trends.whatProductOffers: Counts an Intensive Hospital Stay toward the severity score: 3 consecutive days or more in ICU, or hospitalisation with coma for 96 consecutive hours or more, can raise the score and therefore the payout.

keyFigures.label: Hospitalisation route
keyFigures.condition: general medication or alternative treatment for listed conditions

exclusionsOrConditions: The ICU stay must be 3 consecutive days or more.
The coma must last 96 consecutive hours or more.
The 10-day hospitalisation route applies only to listed conditions such as carcinoma-in-situ, cancer, heart attack or stroke.

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A severity-scored lump-sum plan that covers any disease or injury, paying up to 160% of the sum assured.
notSuitedWhen: The client needs VHIS certification or tax deduction.
The client wants a fixed payout tied to a named critical illness.
The client wants reimbursement of actual hospital bills.
The client will only accept an unlimited payout with no score-based cap.
gapsInSourceMaterial: Premium table and the Sum Assured threshold for the 20% discount
